Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.math

Class VectorDiagram

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.math.VectorDiagram
public final class VectorDiagram extends SceneObject
Animated vector addition, projection, complex multiplication and linear grid transformation. Coordinates use mathematical units in a local centred viewport. PARAM_A in [0,1] controls construction progress. Linear maps interpolate from identity; complex maps interpolate polar rotation and modulus so multiplication visibly rotates and scales.

    • VectorDiagram

      public VectorDiagram(String id, String mode, double ax, double ay, double bx, double by, double m00, double m01, double m10, double m11, double unit)
      Constructs a diagram with two vectors and an optional 2x2 target matrix.
      Parameters:
      id - stable nonblank identity, unique in its owning namespace
      mode - supported construction or plotting mode
      ax - first vector horizontal component
      ay - first vector vertical component
      bx - second vector horizontal component
      by - second vector vertical component
      m00 - target matrix entry at row 0, column 0
      m01 - target matrix entry at row 0, column 1
      m10 - target matrix entry at row 1, column 0
      m11 - target matrix entry at row 1, column 1
      unit - positive pixels per mathematical unit
